messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert CRITICAL -> oncall.sara triggered for svc-ingress-high-5xx (pager id P12345) :rotating_light:

incident-bot: Alert details: 5xx spike observed on /api/v1/generate across us-east-1 gateway. Approx 40% errors, latency up, auto-retries increasing.

sara (oncall): I'm looking. Acknowledge and taking pager. Starting triage.

mike (eng-runtime): Saw a run of RSTs in the ALB logs about 2m ago, could be connection resets from target group. Can someone pull target status?

jon (eng-sre): Running quick health check: `aws elbv2 describe-target-health --target-group-arn arn:aws:...` shows ~30% Unhealthy in tg-redwood-prod-ml.

sara (oncall): Confirmed from Cloudwatch: 502s and 504s spike from ALB -> targets returning 502/connection reset. Graph: CPU on inference nodes normal, but Envoy error counters up.

kevin-sre: Noted similar pattern in us-east-1a only. Suggesting AZ-level networking flaps. Routing table shows some NLB flows timed out.

emily-devex: Customer impact: several active sessions failing in hosted API; throttles/backoffs happening in SDKs. Opening incident ticket INC-2025-228.

mike (eng-runtime): Can we quickly remove unhealthy AZ from ALB? We can set up a de-registration to drain and see if error rate drops.

jon (eng-sre): Doing a targeted deregister now for targets in us-east-1a. Command:
```
aws elbv2 deregister-targets --target-group-arn arn:aws:... --targets Id=i-0abcd1234efgh
```

(small pause)

jon (eng-sre): Deregister complete. Waiting 30s for ALB to rebalance.

sara (oncall): Noting mitigation step in incident doc. Rolling updates paused.

incident-bot: Notifying #product and #support about degraded API in us-east-1, potential partial outage.

kevin-sre: Error rate reduced to ~12% after AZ drain. But still above normal. Envoy shows many downstream resets: `envoy cluster.rst: 1xx` and `upstream_cx_connect_fail`.

mike (eng-runtime): Can we check the ingress controller version? There was a config push earlier today. `kubectl -n ingress get deploy` shows nginx-ingress-controller v1.7.2 updated 3h ago.

emily-devex: Yep saw an automated rollout at 09:08 for a config tweak to keepalive settings. Could that interact with ALB health checks?

jon (eng-sre): Pulling ingress logs `kubectl -n ingress logs deploy/nginx-ingress-controller -c controller --since=10m` yields repeated errors: 
```
[E] 2025-11-08T09:54:21Z upstream reset while reading response
[E] 2025-11-08T09:54:22Z failed to connect to upstream: connection reset by peer
```

sara (oncall): Hypothesis: config change shortened keepalive or changed proxy protocol causing midstream resets under high short-lived connection patterns.

mike (eng-runtime): Quick experiment: revert the keepalive patch on ingress in a canary namespace? Or roll back the controller for all ingress? Rollback would require a deploy-bot approval. Thoughts?

emily-devex: Customers will prefer minimal blast radius. Recommend rolling back the controller globally to previous image (v1.7.1) while we confirm.

sara (oncall): I need a simple mitigation that reduces customer impact fast. Rolling back ingress globally. mike, jon, can you coordinate? I'll continue incident lead.

deploy-bot: Request received to rollout image nginx-ingress-controller:v1.7.1 -> accepted. Starting rollout to ingress namespace.

mike (eng-runtime): Rolling back now. `kubectl -n ingress set image deploy/nginx-ingress-controller controller=nginx-ingress-controller:v1.7.1`

jon (eng-sre): Watching pods come up. New pods becoming ready. Healthchecks are green.

(5m)

jon (eng-sre): Error rate down to 2.6% in us-east-1. Latency back to baseline. ALB target health now 100% healthy.

sara (oncall): Great. Marking as mitigated. Keep monitoring for 30m. Notifying customers via status page and support with timeline and suggested retry guidance.

emily-devex: Posting public note: "We experienced increased 5xx in US-East due to an ingress controller config rollout that caused connection resets; we rolled back and service is restored. Incident report forthcoming." :white_check_mark:

mike (eng-runtime): Follow-up: we'll run a canary matrix for the ingress change with synthetic load tests across AZs to reproduce. Also add additional instrumentation for Envoy reset reasons.

kevin-sre: Action items logged in INC-2025-228: 1) Postmortem owner: mike; 2) Add runbook step for quick AZ drain; 3) Add preflight synthetic across AZs for control-plane config changes.

sara (oncall): Handoff to oncall rotation: @mike will cover the follow-up for the next 8h. I'm stepping off pager.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2025-228 status -> mitigated. Pages cleared.

mike (eng-runtime): I'll start the postmortem draft and include logs, ALB/NLB traces, and the exact config diff.

jon (eng-sre): Note: while rollback fixed symptoms, we should investigate if ALB connection reuse settings combined with nginx keepalive change created a TCP mismatch.

emily-devex: Support queued a list of affected customers (IDs) and will send templated follow-up in 2h.

sara (oncall): Thanks team. Closing thread when the postmortem link is available. :pray:
